svg.text: The 36 co-posts of Tim Ballard and druze.spirit. Each square is one post, coloured by who owns it.
Both are on all 36 posts: one room of two. The only symmetry is swapping them (order 2).
They take turns owning: 18 Tim, 16 druze.spirit, in runs (Aug 29–31 all Tim; Sep–Oct all druze.spirit).
The regulars split by side. Tim's posts hold 2 of the 6, druze.spirit's hold 2, tbfrescue's none.
So no owner holds the whole crew, and the shared-post counts are not equal: no hub, no rotation.
There Tim and Sandra are twins too, but a third account, expofamily.cl, owns posts 11–15 and seats the
whole crew (2, 2, 2). That hub-and-rotation shape is what m was defined from. Here it does not occur.
druze.spirit is on all 200 and alone in its room. It owns 118 posts but holds only 11 of 47 regulars: no m.
Symmetry 39,813,120, almost all from one-post guests; the rest (24) is two pairs and one trio.
Not claimed: who or what runs either account.
Captures: TB 2026-10-17, druze.spirit 2026-10-19 and 11-01. B36's Tim credit was gone on 11-01 (TB × druze.spirit now 35).
